page.overview:
What is Shinbone blade?

Shinbone blade was a dagger forged from beskar owned by the bounty hunter Beilert Valance. It was an effective last resort in case Valance's cyborg systems were incapacitated.

Shinbone blade first appeared in Bounty Hunters 3, a comic written by Ethan Sacks, illustrated by Paolo Villanelli, and published by Marvel Comics In the Star Wars Legends continuity, Shinbone was the homeworld of Beilert Valance developed by Jason Fry for The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale. Shinbone was the town where Liberty Valance from the classic John Ford western The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance lived.
